item.title: Is software engineering dead?
item.description: Software engineering is dead. Today this was the hot topic on X. I think the hot takes on this topic are getting hotter day by day, thanks to the advancements of the AI models and the harnesses supporting them. To be fair, it’s something I have also been thinking about for a while. As I see most of my work getting automated by agents, I sometimes feel like I am catching up rather than steering the workflow. It’s very scary. Not the catching-up part, but the fact that there is no going back.

item.title: The Jitter Bug - How a Little Randomness Makes Your Recommendations Smarter (and More Fun!)
item.description:
The Tyranny of the Top Rank

Ever feel like your favorite music app is playing DJ Déjà Vu, stuck on an endless loop of your top-played genres or artists you already know and love? Or, if you’re an artist, have you wondered how your fresh, amazing track can cut through the noise and find new ears? This isn’t just a feeling; it’s a common challenge in any system that ranks and recommends items – whether it’s songs, movies, products, or even internal company resources.
